notes.example:
Synonimy: acute deterioration / worsening / decompensation

The patient was admitted with an acute exacerbation of COPD.
There has been an exacerbation of her symptoms over the past week.
We managed to prevent further exacerbation with early intervention.

Synonimy: reason to avoid / precaution / absolute bar to

Renal impairment is a contraindication to this contrast agent.
There are no absolute contraindications to this procedure.
Pregnancy is an important contraindication for this medication.

Synonimy: outlook / expected course / likely outcome / clinical trajectory

The prognosis for stage III disease is guarded.
We discussed a more favourable prognosis if he loses weight.
The overall prognosis remains uncertain at this stage.

Synonimy: symptomatic / supportive / comfort-focused / non-curative

The patient has been referred for palliative care input.
We're taking a palliative approach given his advanced disease.
Palliative treatment focuses on symptom control rather than cure.

Synonimy: coexisting condition / concurrent illness / associated condition

He has multiple comorbidities including diabetes and hypertension.
Significant comorbidity was noted on examination.
Her comorbidities will impact the choice of treatment.

notes.back: Badanie wskazuje, że… / Wynik pokazuje, że…
notes.example:
Synonimy: findings suggest / imaging demonstrates / results reveal / the investigation confirms

The CT scan indicates that there is a small effusion.
Blood tests indicate that his clotting is significantly prolonged.
Recent imaging indicates a degree of stenosis in the left artery.

notes.back: Korzyści i ryzyko / Zalety i wady zabiegu
notes.example:
Synonimy: risks and benefits / potential advantages and disadvantages / the risk-benefit profile

I explained the benefits and harms of the proposed treatment.
We discussed the benefits and harms of continuing versus stopping the medication.
The benefits clearly outweigh the potential harms in this case.

Synonimy: no features of / no signs of / there is an absence of / we found no indication of

There is no evidence of acute pathology on imaging.
No evidence of infection was found on the blood cultures.
No evidence of metastatic disease is present.

Synonimy: consistent with / suggestive of / compatible with / in line with

The findings are in keeping with viral hepatitis.
These results are in keeping with our clinical suspicion.
The presentation is in keeping with acute pancreatitis.

Synonimy: in keeping with / suggestive of / compatible with / supportive of

The clinical picture is consistent with sepsis.
The radiological features are consistent with cirrhosis.
His symptoms are consistent with a viral prodrome.

Synonimy: upon assessment / at clinical review / on clinical assessment

On examination, the patient was pyrexial and tachycardic.
On examination, there was marked abdominal distension.
On examination, we found a palpable mass in the right upper quadrant.

Synonimy: we advise / we suggest / the recommendation is / our guidance is that

It is recommended that he continues on current antibiotic therapy.
It is recommended that she undergoes further imaging.
It is recommended that a follow-up appointment is arranged within two weeks.

Synonimy: we plan to / we intend to / our management plan is to / we would suggest

We propose to start him on a trial of beta-blockers.
We propose to review the imaging with radiology before proceeding.
We propose to monitor him closely over the next 48 hours.

notes.back: Bez widocznych zmian / Prawidłowy / Bez cech patologicznych
notes.example:
Synonimy: normal / within normal limits / without abnormality / showing no significant findings

The abdominal examination was unremarkable.
Cardiovascular examination was unremarkable.
Baseline imaging was unremarkable apart from mild degenerative changes.

Synonimy: abnormal / out of range / elevated / impaired / significantly altered

His liver function tests were significantly deranged.
We found deranged coagulation and thrombocytopenia.
Biochemistry showed deranged renal function.

Synonimy: indirect endpoint / proxy measure / intermediate outcome / surrogate marker

We need to be careful — improving the surrogate outcome doesn't guarantee better patient outcomes.
The trial used blood pressure as a surrogate outcome for cardiovascular events.
Surrogate outcomes can be misleading if they don't correlate with true clinical benefit.

Synonimy: highly complex / multifaceted / nuanced / fraught with complexity

The ethical considerations surrounding this case are steeped in complexity.
Decision-making in palliative care is often steeped in complexity.
The management of this condition is steeped in complexity and requires an MDT approach.

She was admitted with acute cardiac decompensation following a chest infection.
Signs of hepatic decompensation included ascites and new-onset confusion.
Close monitoring is needed to detect early decompensation in patients with cirrhosis.
notes.synonyms: acute deterioration / failure of a previously stable condition

notes.example:
Chronic pain is a recognised sequela of shingles.
The long-term sequelae of meningitis can include hearing loss.
She has been left with neurological sequelae following the stroke.

The bleed was considered iatrogenic, secondary to anticoagulation.
Iatrogenic infection is a recognised risk of central line insertion.
We reviewed her medication to rule out an iatrogenic cause of the confusion.

We should strive for an HbA1c of 53 mmol/mol or less, provided this can be achieved without hypoglycaemia.
The unit strives for the shortest possible door-to-needle time in acute stroke.
In rehabilitation, Mrs Evans is striving for independence in washing and dressing.
notes.synonyms: to aim for / to work towards / to seek to achieve

notes.example:
The MRI of your knee is booked for next week. In the meantime, please continue taking ibuprofen as before.
I would be grateful for your assessment of Mr Hall's palpitations. In the meantime, I have advised him to limit caffeine.
She is on the waiting list for cataract surgery; in the meantime, her vision is checked every three months.
notes.synonyms: meanwhile / for the time being / until then

notes.back: zwracać uwagę na problemy, zgłaszać je
notes.example:
Nurses are often the first to highlight problems with a patient's fluid balance.
It is important to highlight problems with medication adherence early, before the patient is discharged.
The audit helped us to highlight problems in the referral process.
notes.synonyms: to flag up problems / to raise concerns / to draw attention to problems

notes.back: ścieżka opieki (ustalona sekwencja postępowania z pacjentem)
notes.example:
Mr Singh has been placed on the stroke care pathway and will be reviewed daily by the physiotherapist.
The hip fracture care pathway aims for surgery on the day of admission or the day after.
If a patient deteriorates, staff should follow the agreed care pathway for suspected sepsis.
notes.synonyms: clinical pathway / treatment pathway / agreed plan of care
